scripts.check: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && biome check packages
scripts.check:fix: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tui/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && biome check --write packages
scripts.test: node --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/cli/test/*.test.ts && bun test packages/tui/test
